points.source: synthetic fixture: Stage 2 photometry of the area's dots (/dots): flux_uJy, flux_err, snr, lambda_um

rel.source: synthetic fixture: the area's stored /dots and /tracks (A17.8) and the solar table
rel.formula: (F / F_sun(lambda)) / median over the visit's short-arm points of (F / F_sun); null for a visit with no short-arm point

calibration.source: synthetic fixture: stars of the area's /dots
calibration.formula: per visit and detector: stars (label star, snr >= star_snr_min) matched within star_match_arcsec between consecutive exposures; sigma_sys = 1.4826 MAD(F_b / F_a - 1); fewer than star_pairs_min pairs: sigma_sys_default

colour.source: synthetic fixture: the area's stored /dots and /tracks (A17.8) and the solar table
colour.assumption: the solar colour of the CALSPEC table, a Kurucz model beyond 2.5 um; no aperture correction per band (Q-23)

distance.source: synthetic fixture: u_inv_au of /tracks (A17.4, Q-179) and the Astronomical Almanac Sun
distance.formula: u_inv_au > 0: Delta = 1/u, r = |S + Delta s|, S = minus the geocentric Sun (Astronomical Almanac low-precision formula) at the middle of the track's times, s the unit vector to its mean RA/Dec; otherwise r = R_earth sin(elongation) for an elongation below 90 deg, else R_earth (the closest the line of sight comes to the Sun)

distance_worst_case.source: synthetic fixture: the Astronomical Almanac Sun and the track's direction
distance_worst_case.assumption: no parallax: the body is taken at the point of the line of sight closest to the Sun, the hottest it could be

verdict.source: synthetic fixture: the area's stored /dots and /tracks (A17.8) and the solar table
verdict.assumption: reflectance ratios within [r_min, r_max]; heat glow bounded by NEATM over the p_V and eta ranges; a body larger than about 200 m spins no faster than the 2.2 h barrier (Pravec and Harris 2000)

sun.assumption: observed solar spectrum below 2.5 um, the Kurucz model above it, scaled to the observed one

formulas.points: a dot of the track with snr >= snr_min is a point; arm = short if wavelength_um < dichroic_um, else long
formulas.calibration: per visit and detector: stars (label star, snr >= star_snr_min) matched within star_match_arcsec between consecutive exposures; sigma_sys = 1.4826 MAD(F_b / F_a - 1); fewer than star_pairs_min pairs: sigma_sys_default
formulas.colour: per exposure, every short-arm point with every long-arm point: rho = (F_L / F_S) / (F_sun(L) / F_sun(S)); (sigma_rho / rho)^2 = (s_L / F_L)^2 + (s_S / F_S)^2 + sigma_sys_S^2 + sigma_sys_L^2; lower limit when F_S < snr_min s_S and F_L >= limit_snr_min s_L: rho > F_L / (max(F_S, 0) + limit_sigma s_S) / (F_sun ratio); upper limit the reverse
formulas.distance: u_inv_au > 0: Delta = 1/u, r = |S + Delta s|, S = minus the geocentric Sun (Astronomical Almanac low-precision formula) at the middle of the track's times, s the unit vector to its mean RA/Dec; otherwise r = R_earth sin(elongation) for an elongation below 90 deg, else R_earth (the closest the line of sight comes to the Sun)
formulas.bounds: rho_max(r) = r_max (1 + G(lambda_L, r)); G = largest NEATM thermal / reflected flux at lambda_L over p_V in [pv_min, pv_max] and eta in [eta_min, eta_max]; NEATM with emissivity, A = phase_integral p_V, the same phase angle in both terms, HG phase function (G = hg_g) for the reflected term, F_sun = pi B_nu(5778 K) (R_sun / au)^2 / r^2
formulas.steps: per visit and detector, consecutive points in time: c = F_b / F_a - 1; allowed = spin + sqrt(2) sigma_sys + slope_arm |ln(lambda_b / lambda_a)| + step_sigma sigma_c, spin = 0.921 2 pi a_max_mag dt / p_min_h; ok when |c| <= allowed
formulas.verdict: first that applies: flickers (a step not ok); too_blue (a pair with rho + pair_sigma sigma_rho < r_min, or an upper limit below r_min); too_red (parallax, a pair with rho - pair_sigma sigma_rho > rho_max, or a lower limit above rho_max); very_red (worst case, a pair with rho - pair_sigma sigma_rho > r_max, or a lower limit above r_max); rock (a pair with rho / sigma_rho >= informative_snr); too_faint (pairs, none informative); one_colour (no pair). heat_glow: parallax rock with a pair rho > r_max
formulas.rel: (F / F_sun(lambda)) / median over the visit's short-arm points of (F / F_sun); null for a visit with no short-arm point
